Volcarona

Bug Fire

Unova · Generation 5

Volcarona is a Bug/Fire-type Sun Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 46 kg. It evolves from Larvesta. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (135), with a base stat total of 550.
